remarks: Special Penthouse Unit in desirable renovated building, conveniently located for Stamford's bustling vibrancy, restaurants, shopping, and commutation. Love at first sight with the most mesmerizing 180-degree unobstructed views of downtown, uptown, and beyond, with eastern exposure maximizing sunrises and floods of natural light. Imagine your front row seats to enjoy and entertain during Stamford's Thanksgiving Balloon Parade, or Santa and friends' arrival during 'Heights & Lights' or the spectacular 4th of July Fireworks Shows, without leaving your home! Spacious Primary Suite with private balcony brings the view to your pillow, and early coffee or late cocktail the perfect bookends for a busy day. Living room with wood-burning fireplace creates a priceless ambiance at any time of the day, and the open dine-in kitchen keeps the chef centered in the action. With all the updates including mechanicals, appliances, and cosmetics already done, just move right in and begin enjoying your new quality of lifestyle. Forward thinking HOA fully engaged to upgrade structure, facade, balconies, lobby, and elevators to best serve current and future owners for decades to come.
